verdict.rationale: Salesforce docs mention pipeline/opportunity management, forecasting, and lead/account/opportunity management features (e.g., 'Advanced Forecast & Pipeline Management', 'Lead, Account, Contact, and Opportunity Management'), implying pipeline tracking exists, but no evidence explicitly confirms a visual, drag-and-drop, customizable-stage Kanban-style pipeline UI. Community feedback highlights complexity and heavy need for customization/consultants, suggesting the feature may require significant setup rather than being simple/out-of-the-box for a founder.
